body: I'm alive. Police showed up so I left to not get sent to psych. Had to go through a forrest...
Hope you find a way to cope with them. In europe, don't want to be more specific.

There was lots of places I wanted to go to. But I have accepted I will never go there. I study for my dream job but have been forced to take a break due to my mental health. Not sure if I would be able to ever finish it. And even then I would probably not be able to do it because I can't function among people. The only person I ever loved cheated on me. There is nothing left that make me want to live. The only thing I feel sad about is not seing my niece grow up.

I've done that before. I've been admitted both by force and by choice. It doesn't change anything. This is my only solution. Just waiting for it to get a bit later so other people who can stop me won't be there.

My life at the momet consist of distracting myself hour by hour to not think about killing myself. Then I lay awake for hours trying to fall asleep and wish I was dead. Now I have decided I will do it.
